title: Worth every penny. Loved our guide!
text:
We LOVED our guide, Laura. She was very knowledgeable and brought Barcelona's history to life in a way that felt relevant today. She answered all of our questions and then some.

We also liked the small group size; it made the tour feel personal. This tour was worth the money, and we highly recommend it if it's your first time in Barcelona.
